bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)
test -n "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e '
const fs=require("fs"),p="/app/runtime/",names=fs.readdirSync(p).filter(n=>/^teaching-(batch|parallel)-/.test(n)).sort();let total=0,unknown=0;for(const n of names){let f=p+n+"/status.json";if(!fs.existsSync(f))continue;let s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));if(typeof s.cost_usd==="number"&&Number.isFinite(s.cost_usd))total+=s.cost_usd;else unknown++;console.log(JSON.stringify({batch:n,status:s.status,cost:s.cost_usd,lessons:(s.lessons||[]).map(x=>({topic:x.topic,status:x.status,verdict:x.verdict,error:x.error})),pending:s.pending}));}const w=require("/app/server/command-module/teaching-weight-registry.js").readWeightManifest();console.log(JSON.stringify({weight_status:w.weight_status,weight_update:w.weight_update,student_model_gate:w.student_model_gate,optimizer_steps:w.optimizer_steps,known_total_usd:total,unknown_cost_batches:unknown}));'
